integrity: The exact identity is proved directly by affine normalization and a 2-by-2 positive-definite quadratic form calculation; computation is used only as replayable verification.
scientific_limitations: The classical minimum-area result is prior work and is not claimed as new.
Full text of the 2024 monograph section on the parallelogram area inequality was not inspected; exact-formula overlap there remains a residual risk.
title: Exact anisotropy law and sharp stability for parallelogram circumellipses
